name: Error
description: Fault screen: a red centre block plus a flashing logo signal that the rig has stopped. Retry (bottom left) returns to the Set Browser once the operator has addressed the fault.
notes: The real rig names the fault by scrolling text across the pads via SysEx 07h — 'NO ASIO', 'SET MISSING', 'LP LOST' — cheaper than a colour code anyone has to memorise. The Lab only mocks the static look; scrolling is hardware-side. The error-spin ring runs on layer 'under': the red centre block, the logo flash and the Retry pad all stay lit and pressable through it.
